title: Manager, Learning Experience and Digital Design
description: Promoted twice in under three years, from Senior Curriculum Developer to Manager of Learning Experience and Digital Design.

roles.title: Manager, Learning Experience and Digital Design
roles.description: Lead design and production of customer education for Okta Customer Acceleration, with a team of 3.
highlights: Proposed Okta’s first customer-facing learning recommendation agent and pitched it to executive leadership. It shipped.
Content for Okta for AI Agents reached 1,500+ views and 155 logged-in customers in its first 2 weeks.
Designed a scalable learning approach for strategic business reviews that became the production standard for a video series serving 500+ customer success managers.
Designed and built Okta’s Oktane conference kiosk: a skill badge experience, and a gamified arcade-style learning moment.

roles.title: Staff Learning Experience Designer
roles.description: Designed courses and simulations for Customer Acceleration.
highlights: Won the CEdMA Pinnacle Award for Innovation, Okta’s first CEdMA recognition since 2017, for placing simulations inside courses.
Raised average course consumption from 2.2 to 8+ across over 1500 learners with in-course simulations, with no matching increase in cost.
Built a shared library of Parta course blocks so new courses start from a template, not a blank page.
Aligned Customer Acceleration’s learning platform, site, communities, and support content to a single design standard.
Grew course video views from 2,452 to 4,386 and connected viewership to learner activity, so we could see which views turned into learners.
Presented the Next Generation Learning webinar and led a hands-on CEdMA Austin session on shipping courses built with AI.

roles.title: Senior Curriculum Developer
roles.description: Built the catalog's feedback loop and added certification courses.
highlights: Built Okta’s first feedback loop connecting learner feedback and video analytics to catalog decisions, and archived 247+ courses with little to no usage.
Added 10+ certification courses in 13 months.
Introduced AI into the team’s course production workflow, resulting in a 2 week savings in time to production.

title: Learning Experience Designer
description: Owned quarterly releases and QA for 300+ courses.
highlights: Shipped quarterly updates for customers and employees with video, simulations, and knowledge checks.
Standardized the build process across 300+ courses, cutting QA time by 2.5 business days per release.
Built Jira workflows that saved the team about 20 hours a week.
Launched a professional development program for the learning team.

title: LMS Analyst, Sales Enablement
description: Ran a learning platform of 1,200+ courses in five languages, connected to Salesforce.
highlights: Localized the platform and the courses for five languages.
Kept employee and partner courses current across 1,200+ titles.
Standardized authoring practices for seven instructional designers.
Raised completion of required courses from 70% to 95%.
Connected learner data to Salesforce so partners could see certifications.
Ran the required-course cycle from assignment through completion.
